title: Mercury footer
description: An airy footer of plain link columns (small muted headings, links in the text colour), four across on desktop and two on phones, then a hairline with a small label on the left and numbered fine print on the right.
notes: the fine-print area is optional; it suits regulated businesses with footnotes up the page
name: mercury-footer
